# to_iridl_lon { #wass2s.to_iridl_lon }

```python
to_iridl_lon(lon)
```

Convert numeric longitude to IRIDL longitude string format.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| lon    | float  | Longitude value in degrees (positive for East, negative for West). | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                            |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | str    | IRIDL-formatted longitude string (e.g., '15E' for +15, '15W' for -15). |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> to_iridl_lon(15)
'15E'
>>> to_iridl_lon(-15)
'15W'
```
